summary: Data analyst and project manager with 5 years in a regulated, multi-country payments business (Global Blue, part of Shift4), promoted three times in four years. Automates reporting, keeps master data accurate across ~40 countries and turns messy data into clear decisions for senior leadership.
cover_letter: I am applying for the Analyst, Banking Operations (Domestic) role at Brex. This role needs someone who turns messy data into clear decisions. For 5 years at Global Blue, part of Shift4, a regulated, multi-country payments business, I have done exactly that, and I have been promoted three times in four years.

I cut a monthly 350,000-row report build from hours to minutes by automating it and documented the seven-source data chain. I built issue-ratio and eligibility monitoring reports in Salesforce that are now used in every monthly business review, and 50+ commercial pricing models across 40 brands.

I produce monthly business reviews and Town Hall packs for senior leadership, including the Shift4 executive team, and I keep a ~600-account international master list accurate for account managers in ~40 countries.

I hold the AgilePM® v3 Practitioner certificate and an MA from the University of Sheffield, and I live in Southampton. I would put early effort into learning SQL, while bringing delivery discipline from a regulated environment.
I would welcome the chance to discuss the role.
